Created four Power BI dashboards providing real-time financial, sustainability product and workforce insights with drilldowns across regions and markets.

bullets.en: Delivered cross-division workshops to build organisational understanding of the EU SAF Mandate and its operational impact.

bullets.zh: 設計自動驗證規則與績效追蹤，整合 140+ 國家的 ESG 與職業健康安全報告，使資料完整性提升 45%。

bullets.zh: 主導即時事故通報系統的全球導入，獲 1,400+ 個據點採用，使反應速度提升 60%，並強化稽核可追溯性。
bullets.en: Led the global rollout of an Immediate Incident Reporting system adopted at 1,400+ sites, improving response speed by 60% and strengthening audit traceability.

bullets.zh: 撰寫符合 ISO 14001 的健康與安全手冊，強化內部永續與合規標準。
bullets.en: Authored a Health & Safety manual aligned with ISO 14001, reinforcing internal sustainability and compliance standards.

bullets.zh: 透過供應商訪談與成本效益分析評估八套 ESG 自動化軟體，支援高階管理團隊決策。
bullets.en: Assessed eight ESG automation software through vendor interview and cost-benefit analysis, supporting Senior Leadership Team decision-making.

bullets.zh: 協助部門主管監測第一線員工流動率，整合人力指標儀表板與 Power Automate 滿意度表單。
bullets.en: Supported the Head of Department to monitor frontline employee turnover by integrating a workforce metrics dashboard with a Power Automate form of satisfaction rate.

bullets.zh: 建立以 OKR 為基礎的系統追蹤中階主管推動項目，提升人力資訊透明度、目標一致性與問責。
bullets.en: Implemented an OKR-based system to track middle-management initiatives, improving workforce visibility, alignment, and accountability.

bullets.zh: 在學習管理系統（LMS）建立能力缺口分析與職涯路徑框架，支援 100+ 名 ITSD 人員的精準培訓。
bullets.en: Developed an ability-gap analysis and career-path framework in Learning Management System (LMS), supporting targeted upskilling for 100+ ITSD employees.

bullets.en: The concept combines TCCIP downscaled climate data, crop-disaster calendars, and DSSAT crop-model principles to show that climate adaptation involves multiple trade-offs.

intro.zh: 我把複雜的永續與營運問題轉化成可執行的策略、清楚的指標與實用的數位工具；並結合 IT、資料與創意參與，設計自動化流程、儀表板、網站與學習體驗，讓跨文化團隊、客戶與社群更容易理解問題、貢獻想法並採取行動。
intro.en: I turn complex sustainability and operational challenges into practical strategies, clear metrics and useful digital tools. Combining IT, data and creative, participatory approaches, I build automations, dashboards, websites and learning experiences that help cross-cultural teams, customers and communities understand problems, contribute ideas and take action.
